name: Dice & Desire
source:
Dice & Desire is an adult visual novel where your fate is written by dice rolls, questionable decisions, and a Dungeon Master who is very aware he's narrating your story.

You play Tav, a fresh adventurer dropped into The Juicy Bunny tavern for what's supposed to be a simple night out. Naturally, it doesn't stay simple. Every conversation, every seduction attempt, every dumb idea you have gets put to a d20 roll.

A tavern full of personalities to charm, annoy, or accidentally seduce, each with their own affection dynamic that actually shapes how scenes play out. AI-generated adult scenes with real interactive control, not just a slideshow, retouched by hand to get the look just right. This is a Prologue, the opening night of a much bigger story, built as an ongoing beta with regular updates.
